rows.name: a tenant signs links to its agent's files with its own token, as for its volumes
fileArguments: other parties' servers are not offered or sent files unless a definition turns it on
files reach a tool as URLs bound to the call: a file at its version, a directory as a snapshot, small ones inline
the TypeScript SDK attaches bytes, Blobs, local paths and workspace files; a file deleted or replaced after attaching still reads as attached
the REST API stores the upload's type and serves downloads with safe headers
signed links: bound to tenant, volume, path, method, expiry, size and content type; tampering fails
a run's outcome lists the files it wrote and presented, and a presented file is an event with a download link
an upload streams to storage a chunk at a time: the source is never more than a few chunks ahead of storage
attachments over REST land in the workspace, the transcript keeps references, and the model sees them natively
application-attached MCP files are saved to the workspace like a server's
MCP images, audio, blobs and long text are saved to the workspace, under sanitized names

OpenAPI operations upload files (multipart, raw bytes, base64) and save binary responses
web_fetch saves PDFs and images to the workspace and shows them to the model
a project is a keyed volume seeded once, mounted with the workspace beside it, and published as checked snapshots
a project is restored in place to a published version, and a check hands what it computed to store and the result
pinned versions outlast keep and the snapshot cap, carry labels, and a snapshot can be made from contents
publishTool finds the project from the call's identity, never its arguments, and tells the model what to fix
